items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: I heard his band with Nat live at a festival in Cleveland in the late 60s

ctx.x: Okay. Let me run a couple of names by you, see if you have anything to opine about. Cannonball Adderley.

Oh one of my favorite players. Wonderful player you know. I heard him, I heard his band with Nat live at a festival in Cleveland in the late 60s, you know the band with Joe Zawinul and Victor Gaskin and Roy McCurdy. I mean part of the fun of Cannonball, I mean he was so good with audiences. I mean when you listen to live Cannonball records they usually kept his audience raps on there and you could hear how good he was — he was a former school teacher so he really connected with audiences on a, not just a musical…
He surely was, and I have — just last week I was playing some of his last recordings, and he could go fairly out himself when he wanted to.
